title: cleome arabica subsp. amblyocarpa
intro: Cleome arabica subsp. amblyocarpa, commonly known as Spotted Spurge, is a plant species in the Cleomaceae family, known for its distinctive spotted or mottled leaves. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Cleome arabica subsp. amblyocarpa include treating wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
